status: Resolved by the user after reinstalling. No production loading code change was needed.

reported_configuration.mode: Single-player loading after importing a save
reported_configuration.data: English original game data with HD pack
reported_configuration.comparison: User confirms the NVIDIA laptop uses the same release, English HD pack and imported save, and loading artwork works there.
reported_configuration.appearance: User confirms only a centered Loading… label on black.

findings.detail: The centered fallback label is created only when GameFiles.exists fails or EIBink.open fails. This decision happens before shader rendering, so a GPU-only image rendering failure cannot itself select this label.
Loading artwork is read from the selected original data root's movies/progres*.bik files. Ingos uses progres3.bik.
Save restore writes new save slots only; permitted backup names cannot target installation paths. The tested restore preserves the active game-data root and mod configuration.
HD Lands 1.5.0 supplies texture archive replacements; loading movies are still read from the original data root.
Core-data validation permits installations without progress movies, so successful game startup does not establish that loading art is present.

runtime.platform: Linux, NVIDIA RTX 3090, Forward+ Vulkan, separate rendering thread, 3840x2160
runtime.isolation: Disposable XDG profiles; published build and installed HD package used read-only. Tests call the release's SaveTransfer, main-menu and separate single-player simulation-service code.

checks.name: Original progress movie and presentation stages
Real single-player menu load with HD Lands
Real save export/import followed by menu load with HD Lands

earlier_runs.name: Single-player without HD
earlier_runs.detail: The artwork check passed. One unrelated cleanup assertion used three process frames; current loader waits up to eight presented frames. Later valid tests allow twelve frames.

earlier_runs.name: First HD fixture
earlier_runs.detail: The generated save omitted mod_config, so the existing legacy-save/profile compatibility gate rejected it before loading. Replaced with a fixture containing ModStore.snapshot(); not evidence of the reported loading failure.

limitations: Windows AMD hardware and the affected installation files are unavailable; no Windows or AMD acceptance claimed.
Save import was exercised through the actual backup/restore methods; the Windows native file picker was not executed.
No release, tag, player profile, quality preset or original movie file was modified.

resolution.detail: Reinstalling fixed the loading artwork. The user suspects their installation files; the precise damaged or missing file was not identified.
